author: Shrimpy
body:
Sometimes we like to sit down for a while and play a certain game nonstop for a few hours. What's YOUR favorite game to binge-play? They can be any game (besides Minecraft) whether it's PC, console, mobile, or even.... BOARD GAMES??? :/

Personally, I'd have to say Mario Kart Wii; I've been getting into that a lot recently. 

Lemme know, lemme know.

Bronson a.k.a. TheBron_cool
